title: Mordheim KB catalogue — hireling rules of catalog/hirelings/*/rules.yaml
description: The catalogue-level rules of the hireling directories (`hired-swords/rules.yaml` and `dramatis-personae/rules.yaml`): the rules that govern hiring in general and that the individual profiles point at with `rule_ids` instead of repeating the prose. A profile's own rules stay inline in its catalogue file; this document holds only the shared ones.

catalog.description: Catalogue id of the document, e.g. `hirelings-hired-sword-rules`.

rules.description: The shared rules. Their ids are `<hireling-root>.rule.<slug>` and are the target of a profile's `rule_ids`.

rule.description: One shared hireling rule: source prose plus the stable id profiles reference. The `runtime` classification of band rules does not apply here — a hireling rule is editorial text the campaign reads, not a duel-engine binding.
